topology: NMOS-input five-transistor OTA driving a PMOS series pass device, closed by a resistive feedback divider, Miller-compensated
circuit_class_citation: series linear regulator: error amplifier + series pass element + resistive feedback divider (Gray & Meyer ch.8; Rincon-Mora, Analog IC Design with Low-Dropout Regulators ch.2)

devices.name: mn_bias
devices.function: diode-connected bias reference of the tail current mirror

devices.name: r_bias
devices.function: bias-setting resistor from the supply into the mirror diode

devices.name: mn_tail
devices.function: tail current source of the differential pair (mirror output)

devices.name: mp_pass
devices.function: series pass device; m is the drive-strength knob

devices.name: cc
devices.function: Miller compensation across the pass device gate drive

spec_knobs.name: divider_ratio
spec_knobs.rationale: the feedback divider sets Vout = Vref * (1 + r1/r2); with only Vout bound the ratio is undetermined and the library default stands in

device_param_exprs.rationale: r1/r2 = divider_ratio - 1 at equal sheet width
divider lower leg is the unit element
upper leg: r1/r2 = divider_ratio - 1, scaled to the total length the bound Iq budget allows
lower leg: the remainder of the bound-Iq-sized divider string

conditions: supply = {supply} V (bound Vin if the spec carries one, else the bound Vout plus 1.5 V of headroom — a testbench condition, not a spec)
reference = {vref} V, implied by the bound Vout and the divider ratio

measured.method: k' and the threshold: two-point square-law fit of sqrt(Id) vs Vgs at saturation, from the OUTER two of three gate biases; the interior point is not used by the fit and its relative error is published as `fit`. Gate drive: the gate voltage a diode-connected instance settles at for a stated current in a stated geometry. Sheet resistance: two LENGTHS at one width, which cancels the end/contact resistance exactly and publishes it separately; a third instance at twice the width says whether the primitive honours `w` at all, and the sheet is withheld when it does not. Capacitance: two SQUARE plates, which separate the area density from the perimeter fringe exactly and publish both.

nmos.basis: threshold-referred: Vth_seed 0.5142 V + [0.25, 0.375, 0.5] of the remaining gate swing 1.286 V, capped at 0.95 of the rail

pmos.basis: threshold-referred: Vth_seed 0.8695 V + [0.25, 0.375, 0.5] of the remaining gate swing 0.9305 V, capped at 0.95 of the rail

not_measured.rsheet_ohm_per_sq: the resolved primitive `sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po_0p35` returns the same resistance at w and at 2w, so it does not honour the drawn width; a sheet resistance derived from a width the device ignored would be fabricated. The per-micron resistance at this primitive's OWN fixed width is published instead.

conditions.bias_strategy: two passes: a supply-referred seed grid whose only product is a preliminary threshold, then a threshold-referred grid at fractions of the remaining gate swing, which is what is published. Each corner's `bias` block states the volts each role was actually measured at.
conditions.fit_points: the outer two of the three; the interior point is the residual witness and is not used by the fit

layout_maxima.measured_from: libs.tech/magic/sky130A.tcl:1983 — `lmax 30.0 wmax 30.0` in `sky130::sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1_defaults` (:1980). MEASURED over EVERY capacitor-class gencell this file defines, of which there are SIX: the two parameterised MiM flavours state the SAME 30.0/30.0 (`..._cap_mim_m3_2` at :1987 states it at :1989), and the other four are `cap_vpp_*` vertical-parallel-plate cells whose geometry is FIXED and named in the cell (04p4x04p6, 08p6x07p8, 11p5x11p7 x2) — they state no lmin, wmin, lmax or wmax at all, so they are not sizeable and neither bound nor contradict the ceiling recorded here. The `cap` role is therefore unambiguous on this family.
layout_maxima.note: a capacitor whose drawn length is above the PDK's own stated maximum is realised as N unit devices in parallel, N and the unit length solved from the PDK's measured area AND perimeter capacitance so the total value is preserved; a device no legal unit set realises is refused by name, never drawn at the maximum

layout_minima.measured_from: libs.tech/magic/sky130A.tech:4831 — `width mrp1 330 "mrp1 resistor width < %d (poly.3)"`; 330 centimicrons = 0.33 um. `mrp1` is the drawn layer magic extracts as `sky130_fd_pr__res_generic_po` (:6068 `device rsubcircuit sky130_fd_pr__res_generic_po mrp1 *poly l=l w=w`), the generic poly resistor this PDK's device_models declares.
layout_minima.note: drawn widths are FLOORED to the target PDK's own rule, not set from it: a family whose minimum sits below the library nominal leaves the geometry unchanged.

_provenance.limits: the topology is a circuit-CLASS selection. Device geometry is the library nominal unless a device_param_expr bound it to a spec value or the target PDK's layout minimum floored it; see fields_bound / fields_defaulted / fields_clamped. A floor makes the geometry DRAWABLE, not correct: it is not a sizing solution and does not re-solve the block.

port_binding.refusal: PORT_BINDING_AMBIGUOUS: the topology names [] that the design's interface declaration does not, and the declaration names ['vbias'] that the topology does not. A rename is only unambiguous when exactly one is left on each side; nothing was renamed.
